tools.name: wayfront_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (customers) of the workspace. GET /clients.

tools.name: wayfront_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by user id. GET /clients/{user}.

tools.name: wayfront_list_companies
tools.description: List client companies (teams) with their members. GET /companies.

tools.name: wayfront_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, newest first. Filter by client user ids. GET /orders.

tools.name: wayfront_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with its status and details. GET /orders/{order}.

tools.name: wayfront_list_order_deliverables
tools.description: List the current deliverables of an order and their latest review decision. GET /orders/{order}/deliverables.

tools.name: wayfront_list_order_messages
tools.description: List all messages of an order, staff and client. GET /order_messages/{order}.

tools.name: wayfront_list_order_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks (checklist items) of an order. GET /order_tasks/{order}.

tools.name: wayfront_list_tickets
tools.description: List helpdesk tickets. Filter by ticket numbers. GET /tickets.

tools.name: wayfront_get_ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket with its status, tags, employees and client. GET /tickets/{ticket}.

tools.name: wayfront_list_ticket_messages
tools.description: List all messages of a ticket, staff and client. GET /ticket_messages/{ticket}.

tools.name: wayfront_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices. Filter by client user ids. GET /invoices.

tools.name: wayfront_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its items and payment state. GET /invoices/{invoice}.

tools.name: wayfront_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring subscriptions. Filter by client user ids. GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: wayfront_list_services
tools.description: List the services the workspace sells, with prices and folders. GET /services.

tools.name: wayfront_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the visible sales and delivery pipelines. GET /pipelines.

tools.name: wayfront_list_pipeline_items
tools.description: List the cards of one pipeline. GET /pipelines/{pipeline}/items.

tools.name: wayfront_list_team
tools.description: List the staff team members of the workspace. GET /team.

tools.name: wayfront_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags defined in the workspace. GET /tags.

tools.name: wayfront_list_tracked_times
tools.description: List tracked time entries across orders. GET /tracked_times.

tools.name: wayfront_post_order_message
tools.description: Post a message on an order. Clients see it unless staff_only is true. Confirm the text with the user first. POST /order_messages/{order}.

tools.name: wayfront_post_ticket_message
tools.description: Post a reply on a ticket. Clients see it unless staff_only is true. Confirm the text with the user first. POST /ticket_messages/{ticket}.

tools.name: wayfront_create_order_task
tools.description: Add a task (checklist item) to an order. POST /order_tasks/{order}.

tools.name: wayfront_set_task_complete
tools.description: Mark an order task complete (complete = true) or open again (complete = false). POST or DELETE /order_tasks/{task}/complete.

tools.name: wayfront_add_order_tags
tools.description: Add tags to an order by tag name or existing tag id. POST /orders/{order}/tags.

tools.name: wayfront_create_ticket
tools.description: Open a helpdesk ticket for a client. An optional message is sent to the client at once. Confirm with the user first. POST /tickets.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wayfront_list_order_deliverables, wayfront_list_order_messages, wayfront_list_tickets, wayfront_get_ticket, wayfront_list_ticket_messages, wayfront_set_task_complete, wayfront_create_ticket · Public sink: wayfront_post_order_message, wayfront_post_ticket_message, wayfront_create_order_task, wayfront_set_task_complete, wayfront_add_order_tags, wayfront_create_ticket · Destructive: wayfront_set_task_complete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wayfront_list_order_deliverables, wayfront_list_order_messages, wayfront_list_tickets, wayfront_get_ticket, wayfront_list_ticket_messages, wayfront_set_task_complete, wayfront_create_ticket · Public sink: wayfront_post_order_message, wayfront_post_ticket_message, wayfront_create_order_task, wayfront_set_task_complete, wayfront_add_order_tags, wayfront_create_ticket · Destructive: wayfront_set_task_complete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
